input_oneliner: Cross-cover page: 62F on the tele floor, nurse says she's dizzy tonight, asking if you want anything ordered

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask timing: continuous vs episodic, how long each episode lasts, and when it started
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Timing is the first branch point of the timing-and-triggers approach

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask triggers: rolling in bed or head turning, standing up, or no trigger
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Trigger determines whether Dix-Hallpike, orthostatics, or HINTS is the right next step

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask symptom quality: spinning, near-faint, or unsteadiness
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Quality is less reliable than timing/triggers but still narrows the branch

reference_targets_freetext.item: Orthostatic vital signs (supine to standing at 1 and 3 min)
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Cheapest objective test in a hospitalized patient with likely volume or medication contributors; a maneuver, so not required under the ask-first rule

reference_targets_freetext.item: Medication review (MAR): new, sedating, or antihypertensive doses in the last 24 hours
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Medication effect is the most common inpatient cause

reference_targets_freetext.item: Gait assessment: can the patient stand and walk unaided
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Gait failure escalates to stroke evaluation

reference_targets_freetext.item: Screen for new focal neurologic symptoms (diplopia, dysarthria, weakness, numbness)
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Focal symptoms escalate to stroke evaluation

should_not_recommend: Commit to a HINTS-vs-Dix-Hallpike pathway before establishing timing and triggers
Order meclizine by phone without evaluating the patient

perturbation_pair.changed_feature: timing/trigger specified: unspecified dizziness -> seconds of spinning each time she turns in bed
perturbation_pair.input_oneliner: Cross-cover page: 62F on the tele floor, nurse says she gets spinning for seconds each time she turns in bed tonight, asking if you want anything ordered
